x-e-e4-01.title: Bayanan Mama da lokacin wasa na Jisu
x-e-e4-01.goal: Ka kwatanta tsare-tsaren da dama a bayanin Mama da lokacin da aboki ya ba da shawara, ka gano inda ba su dace ba, sannan ka ƙi gayyatar da Turanci kana ba da shawarar wani lokaci.
x-e-e4-01.material:
Bayanan da Mama ta bari a kan tebur (rubutu kawai, babu hoto):

Mina,
Shirin yau:
3:30 na yamma. Ki dawo gida.
4:00 na yamma. Darasin piano (minti 30).
5:00 na yamma. Fitar da shara.
6:30 na yamma. Abincin dare tare da Mama da Baba.

Sai abokiyarta Jisu ta aiko da saƙo: “Mu yi wasa a wurin shakatawa daga 4:15 zuwa 5:15 yau!”
x-e-e4-01.thinking.0: Kwatanta lokutan da ke bayanin da lokacin da aka ba da shawara ɗaya bayan ɗaya
x-e-e4-01.thinking.1: Tantance ko lokaci “tsawon wani zangon” da lokaci guda sun zo a lokaci ɗaya
x-e-e4-01.thinking.2: Faɗi da Turanci tare da bayar da hujjoji
x-e-e4-01.prereq.0: Ma’anar p.m. da karanta lokuta (kamar 3:30 da 4:00)
x-e-e4-01.prereq.1: Kalmomi masu sauƙi kamar darasin piano da shara
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk layukan bayanin da lokacinsu ya zo a lokaci ɗaya da shawarar Jisu (4:15–5:15).
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ka kwatanta kowane layi da lokacin wurin shakatawa, “4:15–5:15”, sannan ka duba ko yana ƙarewa kafin ko farawa bayan wannan lokacin.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ga abubuwan da suke ɗaukar lokaci, kamar aji, ƙididdige lokacin da suke ƙarewa.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.a: Kwatanta lokacin dawowarka gida da 4:15, shin kafin ne ko bayan?
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.b: Nemo lokacin fara darasin da lokacin ƙarewarsa, sannan ka ajiye su kusa da lokacin zuwa wurin shakatawa.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.c: Na ɗauke shi a matsayin duba ko lokaci guda yana cikin zangon lokacin wurin shakatawa.
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.r.d: Kwatanta lokacin cin abincin dare da ƙarshen lokacin wurin shakatawa, shin daga baya ne?
x-e-e4-01.s.s1.explain: Darasin piano daga 4:00 zuwa 4:30 ne, saboda haka yana cin karo da lokacin 4:15–4:30; kuma fitar da shara da ƙarfe 5:00 tana cikin zangon 4:15–5:15. Dawowa gida da ƙarfe 3:30 da cin abincin dare da ƙarfe 6:30 suna wajen lokacin wurin shakatawa.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.prompt: Ka amsa wa Jisu da Turanci cikin jimloli biyu ko uku. Nemo dalilai a bayanin da suka hana ka zuwa, ka rubuta su, sannan ka ba da shawarar wani lokaci da ya dace.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka ƙi gayyatar da jimla ɗaya mai “Sorry, I can’t ...”.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ka rubuta tsare-tsare biyun da suka ci karo daga bayanin tare da lokutansu, sannan a ƙarshe ka ba da shawara da “Can we play at ...?”.
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: Yi haƙuri, ba zan iya ba ...
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka ba da dalilai biyu duka, darasin piano da fitar da shara?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka ba da shawarar wani lokaci dabam, kuma wannan lokacin bai ci karo da tsare-tsaren bayanin ba?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Akwai jimlar ƙin yarda kamar “I can’t”?
x-e-e4-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsa mai kyau da ta ba da shawarar zangon lokaci.

x-e-e4-02.title: Tsara lokutan yawo da kare da aikin gida
x-e-e4-02.goal: Ka ƙirƙiri haɗuwa daban-daban na lokacin yawo da na aikin gida waɗanda suka cika duk sharuɗɗan bayanin Baba.
x-e-e4-02.material:
Bayanan da Baba ya bari (rubutu kawai, babu hoto):

Mina,
Ke za ki dawo gida da ƙarfe 4:00 na yamma. Ni zan dawo da ƙarfe 6:30 na yamma.
- Ki yi yawo da kare na minti 30. Kada kafin 5:00 na yamma, zafi ya yi yawa.
- Ki yi aikin gida na minti 60.
- Ki gama duka kafin na dawo.
- Kada ki yi ayyukan biyu lokaci guda.

A ƙasa, rubuta kowane lokaci a matsayin “minti nawa bayan 4:00 na yamma”. Misali, idan kin fara da 4:30, ki rubuta 30; idan kin fara da 5:15, ki rubuta 75.
x-e-e4-02.thinking.0: Ka ƙirƙiri amsa da kanka wadda ta cika sharuɗɗa da dama a lokaci guda
x-e-e4-02.thinking.1: Ƙara tsawon lokacin aikin a kan lokacin farawa don duba lokacin ƙarewa
x-e-e4-02.thinking.2: Duba ko lokutan sun zo a lokaci ɗaya
x-e-e4-02.prereq.1: Kalmomi masu sauƙi kamar fitar da kare yawo da aikin gida
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.prompt: Idan Mina ta fara aikin gida da ƙarfe 5:00, ta fara yawo da kare da ƙarfe 5:30, wane sharadi a bayanin ta karya?
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ƙara tsawon lokacin (a mintuna) a kan lokacin fara kowane aiki don gano lokacin ƙarewarsa.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.hint.1: Zana zangon lokacin ayyukan biyun gefe da gefe a kan layi ɗaya.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.a: Kwatanta lokacin fara yawo 5:30 da 5:00, shin ya fi 5:00 wuri ko baya?
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.b: Sanya aikin gida 5:00–6:00 da yawo 5:30–6:00 gefe da gefe a jadawalin lokaci.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.c: Nemo lokacin ƙarewar ayyukan biyun ta ƙara tsawon kowane aiki a kan lokacin farawarsa.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.r.d: Wannan sharadi game da tsawon lokacin aikin ne, ba lokacin farawa ba.
x-e-e4-02.s.s1.explain: Aikin gida daga 5:00 zuwa 6:00 ne, yawo kuma daga 5:30 zuwa 6:00 ne, saboda haka ayyukan biyun sun zo a lokaci guda daga 5:30 zuwa 6:00. An fara yawo bayan 5:00, kuma duka sun ƙare kafin 6:30, don haka an cika sauran sharuɗɗan.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.prompt: Ka ƙirƙiri tsare-tsare 3 daban-daban da suka cika duk sharuɗɗan bayanin. w shi ne lokacin fara yawo, k kuma lokacin fara aikin gida (minti nawa bayan 4:00 na yamma).
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka ƙayyade zangon da w zai iya kasancewa don fara yawo, sannan ka zaɓi lokacin fara aikin gida k wanda ba ya cin karo da lokacin yawo.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo lokacin ƙarewa ta hanyar ƙara tsawon aikin a kan lokacin farawa, sannan ka duba ko ayyukan biyu sun zo a lokaci guda.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.var.k: Lokacin fara aikin gida (k minti bayan 4:00)
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.ok.c1: An rubuta lokacin a sigar da ta dace.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Rubuta w da k a matsayin cikakkun lambobi (minti) da suka fi ko daidai da 0.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Yawo ko aikin gida ya ƙare bayan 6:30.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.ok.c4: Lokutan ayyukan biyu ba su zo a lokaci guda ba.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Lokutan yawo da aikin gida sun zo a lokaci guda.
x-e-e4-02.s.s2.explain: Dole ne a fara yawo tsakanin minti 60 da 120 (5:00–6:00), aikin gida kuma a fara shi cikin minti 90 (kafin ko da 5:30). Daga cikin waɗannan, haɗuwar da ba sa cin karo da juna su ne amsoshin. Misalai: (yawo 60, aikin gida 0), (yawo 90, aikin gida 0), (yawo 60, aikin gida 90).

x-e-e4-03.goal: Duk lokacin da ka karanta layin saƙo, sake hasashen abin da abokinka yake so, kana gyara hasashen da ka yi a baya bisa ga sabbin alamu.

x-e-e4-03.thinking.0: Sauya hasashenka duk lokacin da alamu suka ƙaru
x-e-e4-03.thinking.1: Ka gane cewa jimla guda ba ta isa a gane ba
x-e-e4-03.thinking.2: Ka rubuta amsa da Turanci kana amfani da dalili (alamu) a matsayin hujja
x-e-e4-03.prereq.0: Kalmomi masu sauƙi kamar sanyi da sansani
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.prompt: Karanta rubutun Ken a hankali, sashe ɗaya bayan ɗaya; a kowane lokaci ka yi hasashen abin da Ken yake so.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo sabuwar kalma ko lamba guda a wannan sashe.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ka kwatanta hasashenka na baya da sababbin alamun ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ka bincika ko har yanzu ya dace da su duka.

x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ba za ka iya sani daidai daga layi guda kaɗai ba. Wataƙila yana ba da labari ne kawai, ko kuma yana iya gayyatar a yi wasa tare.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Yana son ya ba ni labarin cewa yana da sabon wasa.

x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kamar dai zai roƙe ni in yi wasan tare da shi.
x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wataƙila yana son mu yi shi tare. A yanzu alamar ba ta da ƙarfi, hasashe ne kawai.

x-e-e4-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Yana son mu yi wasa tare bayan ya warke.

x-e-e4-03.s.s1.reflect: Cikin hasashe ukun da ka yi, a ina ne ya fi canzawa? Faɗi jimla guda da ta jawo canjin.

x-e-e4-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka ci gaba da batun wasan Ken?
x-e-e4-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Akwai wani abu da bai dace da alamun baya ba, kamar cewa za ka je gidansa yau?

x-e-e4-04.title: Menene buƙatar da ke cikin imel ɗin Sora?

Abokai uku sun bayyana abin da Sora take so.

x-e-e4-06.title: Me ya kamata in tambayi Ben?
x-e-e4-06.goal: Nemo bayanin da ya ɓace daga shiri, sannan ka ƙirƙiri tambayoyin Turanci biyu da kanka domin samun bayanin.
x-e-e4-06.material:
Ben ya aika wa Mina saƙo: “Let’s do our science homework together on Saturday. Come to my house!”

Yanayin Mina: Ben ya ƙaura zuwa sabon gida, kuma Mina ba ta san inda sabon gidan yake ba. Mina tana da ajin iyo a ranar Saturday daga 10 na safe zuwa 11 na safe.
x-e-e4-06.thinking.0: Bambance bayanin da ya ɓace da bayanin da ka riga ka sani.
x-e-e4-06.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri tambayoyin da za su samo bayanin da ya ɓace.
x-e-e4-06.thinking.2: Rubuta tambayoyi da suke la’akari da sharuddan kanka.
x-e-e4-06.prereq.0: Ƙirƙirar tambayoyin wane lokaci, ina, da ta yaya.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.prompt: Domin tsara shiri, zaɓi duk bayanan da Mina dole ne ta tambayi Ben game da su.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta dabam bayanin da ke cikin saƙon Ben da wanda ba ya ciki.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.hint.1: Daga yanayi biyu na Mina, nemo abin da har yanzu ba ta sani ba.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.o.a: Wane lokaci ya kamata ta zo.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.r.a: Wannan bayani yana da alaƙa da jadawalin Mina na ranar Saturday.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.o.b: Abin da Ben ya ci da safe.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.r.b: Ko da kana sha’awar sani, ka yi tunani ko bayanin ne kake bukata domin tsara shirin.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.o.c: Hanyar zuwa sabon gidan Ben ko adireshin.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.r.c: Wannan bayani yana da alaƙa da abin da Mina har yanzu ba ta sani ba a yanayinta.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.o.d: Wane darasi aikin gida yake kai.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.r.d: An riga an ambaci darasin a saƙon Ben. Ka bincika ko kana bukatar sake ganowa.
x-e-e4-06.s.s1.explain: Ba a faɗi lokaci ba, saboda haka ba za ta iya sanin ko ya zo daidai da ajin iyo ba; kuma ba ta san inda sabon gidan yake ba, don haka ba za ta iya zuwa ba. Darasin aikin gida (science) yana cikin saƙon, abincin safe kuma ba shi da alaƙa da shirin.
x-e-e4-06.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta tambayoyin Turanci biyu da za ka aika wa Ben. Tambaya ɗaya ta kasance game da lokaci, ɗayar kuma game da wuri.
x-e-e4-06.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi kalmomin tambaya. Tambayar lokaci na iya farawa da What time, tambayar wuri kuma da Where ko How.
x-e-e4-06.s.s2.hint.1: Saka alamar tambaya (?) a ƙarshen kowace tambaya, sannan ka yi tunani ko za ka iya yin tambayar lokaci dalla-dalla saboda ajin iyo.
x-e-e4-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Tambaya ɗaya game da lokaci ce, ɗayar kuma game da wuri?
x-e-e4-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Saboda ajin iyo na (10-11), zan iya fayyace tambayar lokaci dalla-dalla?
x-e-e4-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka saka alamar tambaya a ƙarshen jimlolin?
x-e-e4-06.s.s2.modelNote.1: Tambaya ce takamaimai da ta yi la’akari da ajin iyo.

x-e-e4-07.title: Laburare biyu, jimla guda.
x-e-e4-07.topic: Gyara jimlar da ta jawo rashin fahimta.
x-e-e4-07.goal: Nemo jimlar da ta jawo rashin fahimtar, sannan ka sake rubuta ta da Turanci domin ta ba da ma’ana iri ɗaya ba tare da rashin fahimta ba.
x-e-e4-07.material: Wannan labari ne game da Jisu da Ben. Akwai laburare biyu a wannan gari. Ɗaya shi ne City Library da ke kusa da wurin shakatawa, ɗayan kuma laburaren makaranta da ke cikin makarantar. Ranar Saturday an rufe laburaren makaranta. A cikin layukan da ke ƙasa, jimla guda ta jawo rashin fahimta.
x-e-e4-07.thinking.0: Nemo jimlar da ta jawo rashin fahimtar.
x-e-e4-07.thinking.1: Nemo bayanin da ya ɓace (wace laburare ce).
x-e-e4-07.thinking.2: Bincika ko jimlar da aka sake rubutawa ta ƙara bayanin.
x-e-e4-07.prereq.0: Kalmomi masu sauƙi kamar library, school, da park.
x-e-e4-07.s.s1.prompt: Wane layi ne yake da kalmomin da suka sa abokan biyu ba su haɗu ba?
x-e-e4-07.s.s1.hint.0: Bincika layuka na 3 da 4 don gano inda Jisu da Ben suke kowannensu.
x-e-e4-07.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo layin da yake da kalmar da ta sa su yi tunanin wurare dabam-dabam.
x-e-e4-07.s.s1.explain: “The library” a layi na 1 bai gaya maka ko City Library ce ko laburaren makaranta ba. Nahawun jimlar daidai ne, amma ba a bayyana wurin ba, saboda haka su biyun sun je laburare dabam-dabam.
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.prompt: Sake rubuta layi na 1 da Turanci domin Ben ya iya zuwa inda Jisu take. Bar ranar da lokacin yadda suke.
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunani game da wurin da Ben yake hango idan ya karanta “the library”.
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ƙara wani furuci kafin ko bayan “library” da yake bayyana wurin (suna, wurin kusa da shi, da sauransu).
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Za ka iya gane wace laburare ce nan take?
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bar ranar da lokacin jimlar asali yadda suke?
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Bayan ya karanta, Ben ba zai bukaci sake tambaya ba?
x-e-e4-07.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsa ce da ta bayyana wurin ta hanyoyi biyu har ma ta yanke shawarar inda za su haɗu.

x-e-e4-08.topic: Gyara jimlar da ta jawo rashin fahimta.
x-e-e4-08.title: Wace ce “she”?
x-e-e4-08.goal: Nemo rashin fahimtar da wakilin suna ya jawo, sannan ka sake rubuta shi a sarari ta hanyar canza shi zuwa suna ko furuci kai tsaye.
x-e-e4-08.material:
Hana ta aika wa Jisu saƙo: “Mina ta gaya wa Sora cewa ita tana da manne.”

Abin da Mina ta faɗa da gaske shi ne, “Sora, ke ki zo da mannen.” Amma washegari a ajin zane, babu wanda ya zo da manne.
x-e-e4-08.thinking.0: Nemo duk mutanen da wakilin suna zai iya nufi
x-e-e4-08.thinking.1: Bayyana dalilin da rashin fahimta ke faruwa
x-e-e4-08.thinking.2: Gyara ta zuwa jimla da ba za ta jawo rashin fahimta ba
x-e-e4-08.prereq.0: Kalmomi na asali kamar she, he, da told
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk mutanen da “she” zai iya nufi a jimlar Hana.
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ƙirga sunayen mutane nawa suka bayyana a jimlar.
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo duk sunayen ’yan mata da suka zo kafin “she”.
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.r.a: Hana ce ta rubuta jimlar. Duba ko sunanta yana cikin jimlar.
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ce mutumin da ya zo kafin “told” a jimlar.
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.r.c: Mutumin da ya zo bayan “told” ma zai iya zama “she”.
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.r.d: Wannan ce mutumin da ya karɓi saƙon. Duba ko sunanta yana cikin jimlar.
x-e-e4-08.s.s1.explain: A cikin “Mina told Sora that she has the glue,” “she” na iya nufin Mina ko Sora. Hana da Jisu ba su bayyana a jimlar ba. Idan Jisu ta fahimci cewa Mina ce, za ta yi tunanin Mina ce za ta kawo mannen.
x-e-e4-08.s.s2.prompt: Sake rubuta jimlar Hana da Turanci ta yadda zai bayyana cewa Sora ce za ta kawo mannen. Kada ka yi amfani da “she”.
x-e-e4-08.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka tuna cewa abin yana rikitarwa ne domin akwai mutane biyu da “she” zai iya nufi.
x-e-e4-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ka gwada amfani da suna maimakon “she”, ko kuma ka rubuta ainihin abin da Mina ta faɗa a cikin alamun zance.
x-e-e4-08.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: Mina ta gaya wa Sora ...
x-e-e4-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Shin a bayyane yake cewa mutum ɗaya ne kawai zai kawo mannen?
x-e-e4-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Babu wani abu da zai iya sake rikita mutane, kamar wakilin suna “she” ko “her”?
x-e-e4-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Shin yana da ma’ana ɗaya da abin da Mina ta faɗa tun farko (Sora ce za ta kawo shi)?
x-e-e4-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsa ta dabi’a da ta yi amfani da rahoton magana ta hanyar “to bring”.

x-e-e4-09.s.s1.prompt: Ka rubuta saƙon da za ka aika wa abokiyarka Jisu cikin jimlolin Turanci ɗaya ko biyu. Ka gaya mata ba za ka iya zuwa ba da dalili.

x-e-e4-10.topic: Rubuta ta dabam ga aboki da malami
x-e-e4-10.title: Aika saƙon da aka rubuta wa aboki zuwa ga malami
x-e-e4-10.goal: Nemo sassan saƙon aboki da ba su dace da malami ba, sannan ka sake rubuta yanayi ɗaya ta yadda zai dace da malami.
x-e-e4-10.material:
Saƙon da aka aika wa abokiya Jisu (rubutu kawai, babu hoto):

“Hey! Ba ni da lafiya lol. Ba zan zo 2 school 2morrow ba. Gimme the homework pls!”

(Af haka, ana karanta 2morrow da “tu-morrow”, gajeriyar hanyar rubuta tomorrow.) Kana son aika wa malaminka irin wannan saƙon ta imel.
x-e-e4-10.thinking.0: Nemo kalmomin da ba su dace da wanda zai karɓi saƙon ba
x-e-e4-10.thinking.1: Ka bar yanayin (dalilin) yadda yake, ka sauya salo kawai
x-e-e4-10.prereq.1: Yadda ake karanta gajerun kalmomin saƙonnin waya
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk sassan da dole ne a gyara idan za a aika wa malami wannan saƙon.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.hint.0: Karanta shi da babbar murya kamar kana magana da malami.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.hint.1: Duba dabam-dabam gajerun rubutun, kalmomin yau da kullum, da yadda aka yi roƙon.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.r.a: Dalilin rashin lafiya wani yanayi ne da ya kamata ka gaya wa malamin ma. Ka yi tunani ko ya kamata a canza shi ko a bar shi.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.r.b: Kwatanta cewa mai karɓar malami ne da yanayin wannan furuci.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi tunani ko amfani da lambobi maimakon kalmomi ya dace da rubuta wa malami.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.r.d: Duba ko yadda aka yi roƙon ya dace da malami.
x-e-e4-10.s.s1.explain: “lol”, gajerun rubuce-rubucen lambobi “2 school 2morrow”, da “Gimme ... pls!” salon magana ne tsakanin abokai, saboda haka dole a gyara su idan za a aika wa malami. Dalilin rashin lafiya (“Ba ni da lafiya”) yanayi ne da ya kamata a kiyaye.
x-e-e4-10.s.s2.prompt: Sake rubuta abin da ke ciki iri ɗaya da Turanci a matsayin imel zuwa ga Malama Kim. Ka fara da gaisuwa, ka haɗa cewa ba ka da lafiya, ba za ka iya zuwa gobe ba, da roƙon a sanar da kai aikin gida.
x-e-e4-10.s.s2.hint.0: Ka bar yadda yake ɓangaren (yanayin) da ba ka zaɓa a mataki na 1 ba.
x-e-e4-10.s.s2.hint.1: Sauya “Gimme the homework” zuwa jimlar roƙo kamar “Could you please ...?”.
x-e-e4-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka fara da gaisuwar da ta dace da malami?
x-e-e4-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka cire duk gajerun kalmomin abokai da kalmomin yau da kullum?
x-e-e4-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Yanayin (rashin lafiya) da roƙon (aikin gida) duk suna nan har yanzu?
x-e-e4-10.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsa da ta ma bayar da shawarar karɓar aikin daga aboki.
